#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

void addEdge(const vector<vector<int>>& grid, vector<int> g[], int i, int j, int s, int t) {
    int n = grid.size() - 1;
    int m = grid[0].size() - 1;
    if (s <= 0 || t <= 0 || s > n || t > m) return;
    g[grid[i][j]].push_back(grid[s][t]);
}

bool bfs(const vector<int> g[], int pairU[], int pairV[], int dist[], int m) {
    std::queue<int> q;
    for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
        if (pairU[u] == 0) {
            dist[u] = 0;
            q.push(u);
        } else {
            dist[u] = INT_MAX;
        }
    }
    int maxDist = INT_MAX;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (dist[u] < maxDist) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                if (pairV[v] == 0) {
                    maxDist = dist[u] + 1;
                } else if (dist[pairV[v]] == INT_MAX) {
                    dist[pairV[v]] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.push(pairV[v]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return maxDist != INT_MAX;
}

bool dfs(const vector<int> g[], int u, int pairU[], int pairV[], int dist[]) {
    if (u != 0) {
        for (int v : g[u]) {
            if (pairV[v] == 0 || (dist[pairV[v]] == dist[u] + 1 && dfs(g, pairV[v], pairU, pairV, dist))) {
                pairU[u] = v;
                pairV[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        dist[u] = INT_MAX;
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int hopcroftKarp(const vector<int> g[], int m, int n) {
    vector<int> pairU(m + 1, 0);
    vector<int> pairV(n + 1, 0);
    vector<int> dist(m + 1, 0);
    int result = 0;
    while (bfs(g, pairU.data(), pairV.data(), dist.data(), m)) {
        for (int u = 1; u <= m; u++) {
            if (pairU[u] == 0 && dfs(g, u, pairU.data(), pairV.data(), dist.data())) {
                result++;
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    long long total = 0;

    if (n > 100) {
        int remN = (n - 100) % 6;
        long long qN = (n - 100) / 6;
        total += qN * 6 * m;
        n = 100 + remN;
    }

    if (m > 100) {
        int remM = (m - 100) % 6;
        long long qM = (m - 100) / 6;
        total += qM * 6 * n;
        m = 100 + remM;
    }

    vector<vector<int>> grid(n + 1, vector<int>(m + 1, 0));
    int uLabel = 1;
    int vLabel = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                grid[i][j] = uLabel++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 != 0) {
                grid[i][j] = vLabel++;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<int> adj[uLabel];
    for (int i = 0; i < uLabel; i++) {
        adj[i] = vector<int>();
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 0) {
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i - 3, j);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i - 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i - 2, j + 1);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i, j - 3);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i - 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i + 1, j - 2);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i, j + 3);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i - 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i + 1, j + 2);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i + 3, j);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i + 2, j - 1);
                addEdge(grid, adj, i, j, i + 2, j + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    int maxMatch = hopcroftKarp(adj, uLabel - 1, vLabel - 1);
    total += 2LL * maxMatch;
    cout << total << "\n";
    return 0;
}
